environment.description: Kubernetes pod running as root with no MAC enforcement. The log file at /var/log/websocket-service/messages.log is consumed by a Fluentd sidecar that parses pipe-delimited fields and forwards to Elasticsearch. The Fluentd config uses a regex parser that trusts field boundaries. A log aggregation dashboard (Kibana) renders log fields without additional sanitization. The container runs with default Docker seccomp profile only.

config.log_consumer: fluentd with pipe-delimited regex parser forwarding to Elasticsearch/Kibana
config.filesystem: writable, no restrictions on log path
